name: Sumadera Kasumi
source: Sumadera Kasumi is the younger sister of [url=/c1342]Ushiromiya Kyrie[/url]. Since her sister married with Rudolf, she bore extreme resentment towards Kyrie, to the point of loathing everything about her sister, including [url=/c13708]Ushiromiya Ange[/url].
